referents.why: Third plural 'they' (masculine) is the Jews of 3:1, who are not among the candidates; the candidates are a way, oracles (neuter plural) and God, none of them a people who could be entrusted.

links.why: 'Chiefly that they were entrusted' gives the chief advantage; the text states no reason for the entrusting.
cl2 is the content of cl1's 'chiefly that ...', a clause nested in cl1's predicate.
'Much in every way' is not explained by its own detail; cl1 is the first of the ways it names.
'First of all' gives the first detail of 'much in every way'.

none_fit.what: 'The first advantage is that X': a clause that is the predicate of a copula. No link type covers a predicate that clause; recorded as within.
The Jews named in 3:1 are not a candidate; 3:1's candidate list holds only benefit and circumcision.
